origin.description: Print whether clipr can use the system clipboard.

arguments.text: Passed to the same check as clipr_available.

origin.details: When the clipboard is usable, the message says clipr has read/write access. Otherwise the message is the error from the failed write, including the CLIPR_ALLOW refusal and missing clipboard tools.
